title: Synthetic Gym Membership Relational Dataset
subtitle: 3,000 synthetic members: visits, payments, contracts and PT sessions
description: See kaggle_dataset.md. Fully synthetic gym data (no real records), 2023-01 to 2026-08, eight related tables for churn, revenue and visit prediction.

resources.description: Members: join date, age, home club, gender, corporate flag
Membership plans and net prices in SAR
Membership contracts with start and end dates
Payments with net, VAT and gross amounts, method, refunds
Turnstile swipes, Allowed or Denied with reason
Personal training sessions, completed or cancelled
Monthly feature table with 30 day churn label
